purpose: Teach: 理系/支局/新卒/勘弁/不適切/言い分/脱却/未定

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 当社、本気で、絶対、理系、絶対、出身者、絶対、増えてきましたね
lines.en: We've definitely been seeing more STEM graduates joining the company lately.
lines.style: Measured opening, thoughtful pace. Slight upturn at the end—a genuine observation, not a complaint. Professional warmth, like she's inviting agreement.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。海外、本気で、絶対、支局、絶対、と、絶対、連携、絶対、しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We're working closely with our overseas branches—grateful for that partnership.
lines.style: Steady, affirming tone. Even pacing, slightly formal register. Nod-weight on the affirmation at the start. Sincere without being effusive.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 本気で、絶対、新卒、絶対、研修、絶対、改善しましょう
lines.en: Let's make sure we're improving the new-graduate training program.
lines.style: Forward-leaning, purposeful delivery. Slight emphasis on the verb—framing this as actionable. Collaborative in tone, not directive. Opening attack is engaged.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。本気で、絶対、勘弁、絶対、してくださいというお声、絶対、ありがたいです、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We really value hearing when people ask us to reconsider things—that feedback is invaluable.
lines.style: Humble, listening posture in the voice. Slower on the gratitude statement. Respectful cadence. Not defensive—genuinely receptive. Weight on 'invaluable.'

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 社内、本気で、絶対、不適切、絶対、な、絶対、発言、絶対、無くしましょう
lines.en: Let's work to eliminate inappropriate comments in the workplace.
lines.style: Clear, steady conviction. Formal register rises slightly. Not angry—resolute. Opening attack is clean and direct. Slight pause-weight before 'inappropriate' to let it land.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員の、本気で、絶対、言い分、絶対、しっかり、絶対、伺っております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We're making sure to listen carefully to what our employees have to say.
lines.style: Earnest and grounded. Mid-paced, respectful. Emphasis on 'listen carefully'—showing this is actually happening, not just promised. Steady eye-contact register.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 業界、本気for、絶対、古い慣習、絶対、脱却、絶対、しましょう
lines.en: Let's move past outdated industry practices that don't serve us anymore.
lines.style: Forward momentum in the delivery. Slight edge of determination—not heavy-handed, but clear-sighted. Opening word crisps up. Closing verb has conviction. Professional but future-facing tone.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。次回会議、本気で、絶対、未定、絶対、確認中です、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We're confirming details about the next meeting—thank you for your patience as we finalize that.
lines.style: Closing statement, slightly lower energy than earlier lines. Polite and factual. Acknowledgment of gratitude weaves through naturally. Steady, professional finish. Light trailing quality at the end.
